integrity: Symbolic proof of all field orders and exponents, supported but not replaced by exhaustive finite-field computational checks. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only multiplication by homogeneous quadratic forms in \(\mathbb F_q[x,y]/(x^m,y^m)\), \(m\ge3\). Independent mathematical audit and exhaustive historical literature certification were not performed. Numata arXiv:2002.12649 is a close determinant-level predecessor whose full text was not obtained; an equivalent rank-enumeration formulation remains possible.
title: Quadratic multiplication-rank spectra of two-variable monomial complete intersections
